👨‍💻 Sabiway API Documentation - Admin Endpoints

Admin-only endpoints for managing users.

Retrieve a list of all users (admin only).

Response:
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "full_name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "is_active": true,
    "is_staff": false,
    "is_superuser": false
  },
  {
    "id": 2,
    "full_name": "Jane Smith",
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "is_active": true,
    "is_staff": true,
    "is_superuser": false
  }
]

Retrieve details of a single user (admin only).

Response:
{
  "id": 1,
  "full_name": "John Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "is_active": true,
  "is_staff": false,
  "is_superuser": false
}

Create a new user (admin only).

Request Body:
{
  "full_name": "Alice Johnson",
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "password": "securepassword"
}

Response:
{
  "id": 3,
  "full_name": "Alice Johnson",
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "is_active": true,
  "is_staff": false,
  "is_superuser": false
}

Update an existing user (admin only).

Request Body:
{
  "full_name": "Alice K. Johnson",
  "is_active": true,
  "is_staff": true
}

Response:
{
  "id": 3,
  "full_name": "Alice K. Johnson",
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "is_active": true,
  "is_staff": true,
  "is_superuser": false
}

Partially update a user (admin only). Send only the fields you want to update.

Request Body:
{
  "is_active": false
}

Response:
{
  "id": 3,
  "full_name": "Alice K. Johnson",
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "is_active": false,
  "is_staff": true,
  "is_superuser": false
}

Delete a user (admin only).

Response:
{
  "message": "User deleted successfully"
}
